title: Side Sewer Repair and Replacement Bellevue WA — Camera Inspections, Trenchless Options, Permits and Inspections

search_intent: A Bellevue homeowner with slow drains, roots or a failing side sewer wants to know what the City owns versus the owner, how a camera inspection works, whether open trench, pipe bursting or lining fits, which Bellevue permits and inspections apply, and how to vet the contractor.
local_angles: BCC 24.04.115: private side sewers owned and maintained by property owner incl. cleanouts, check valves, pumps; utility owns mains and stubs in ROW
Bellevue Wastewater: sewage backup with no water use -> 425-452-7840; slow drains -> private service; location info 425-452-4187; no private locates
Side sewer permit required for minor repair, replacement, revision, added connection; clearing and grading for long runs
Side Sewer Permit via MyBuildingPermit: Bill-to, King County Sewer Use Certification, site plan; ROW use permit, as-built packet
Permit conditions: no backfill before inspection; 5/8-inch minus crushed rock, no pea gravel; ROW 6-inch PVC SDR 35, separate ROW permit; easement 48-hour notice; 811
Relining: ASTM F1216, manufacturer license and certified installers, CCTV, no protrusion; pipe bursting: HDPE 24-hour rest, anchors within 3 ft, DR 26, 4-inch min
BCC 24.04.170: licensed contractors or owners; permit on site; designated stub
